Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am employed by Blue Sparrow Tech. I am writing to inquire about group booking availability at City Hub Tokyo for a party of 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Room availability for 10 guests
- Rate per person or total group rate
- Any special amenities or services for groups
- Booking requirements and cancellation policy

I would appreciate a prompt response as we are planning our stay for June. Please let me know if you need any additional information from my side.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
+1 327-420-4923
